title: Sales administration
heading: What is missing before a mission can start or be renewed
subtitle: One row per file, its reason, and the screen where you fix it.
loadFailed: The list could not be loaded. This is not “nothing to handle”: try again in a moment.
renewalsTruncated: The renewal list may be incomplete: your workspace holds more than this screen can read at once. Some files may be missing, with no error shown elsewhere.
empty: No file to handle in this selection.
emptyWhy: This month's starts and the upcoming renewals show up here. Change month or drop a filter to widen it.
qualityTitle: File quality — click a reason to keep only that one
deltaUnmeasured: Change from last month: not measured
unknownAccountReason: This mission is not attached to any account.

tileReasons.all: How many files the period holds.
tileReasons.starts: Missions whose start date falls in the month shown.
tileReasons.renewals: Missions whose renewal window is open.
tileReasons.active: Files carried by a running mission.
tileReasons.ready_to_invoice: Files whose month is already ready to invoice.
tileReasons.in_negotiation: A mission has no “in negotiation” state.

repairs.set_billing_contact: Set the billing contact on the mission
repairs.ask_po: Ask the client for the purchase order
repairs.set_client_reference: Enter the reference the client requires on the invoice
repairs.set_billing_entity: Name the entity the invoice is addressed to
repairs.record_payment_details_sent: Record that the payment details were sent
repairs.validate_kyc: Check the entity's identity on the client record

reasons.unknown_payment_terms: Nobody entered a payment delay. Without it, no due date can be worked out.
reasons.payment_details_not_transmitted: The payment details were never sent to the client.
reasons.kyc_not_measured: This reason is not computed yet. Zero would read as “nothing to check”, which nobody has measured.
reasons.unknownOpening: We do not know when this file opened: the mission has neither a start date in the month nor an end date.

fields.billingEntityFailed: This client's entities could not be read. The list is not empty: it is unknown.
fields.paymentDetailsNote: We only record that you sent them, and when. No bank details are kept here.
